chapterInfo.content:
27
Hiob kyerɛ ne bemdie ne abɔnefoɔ ahotɔ a ɛnkyɛ
1Na Hiob kɔɔ so maa n’abebusɛm so sɛ:
2Sɛ Onyankopɔn a wayi me bem korɔ
ne Otumfoɔ a ɔhyɛ me kra awerɛhoɔ no te aseɛ yi, —
3na m’ahome nyinaa da so wɔ me mu,
na Nyankopɔn ahome da so wɔ me hwene mu yi,
4 # Dwom 34.13 ampa ara, m’ano renka amumuyɛsɛm,
na me tɛkyerɛma renka nnaadaasɛm!
5Ɛmpare me sɛ mɛbu mo bem;
meremma wɔnyi me mudie mfiri me ho de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ mɛgyaa mu.
6 # Aso 24.16; 1 Ko 4.4 Mɛkura me tenenee mu denden, na merennyaa mu;
m’akoma remmu me fɔ, me nna biara ho.
7Me tamfo nyɛ sɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ,
na deɛ ɔma ne ho so tia me no nyɛ sɛ omumuyɛfoɔ.
8 # Luk 12.20 Na ɛdeɛn ne ɔbɔnefoɔ anidasoɔ berɛ a wɔtwa ne nkwa soɔ,
berɛ a Onyankopɔn twe ne kra korɔ no?
9Onyankopɔn bɛte ne sufrɛ
berɛ a ahohiahia bɛba ne soɔ no anaa?
10Anaasɛ n’ani bɛgye Otumfoɔ ho,
ɔbɛfrɛ Onyankopɔn berɛ nyinaa mu anaa?
11Mɛkyerɛ mo Nyankopɔn nsa ho asɛm,
deɛ ɛwɔ Otumfoɔ hɔ no, merensi so.
12Hwɛ, mo deɛ, mo nyinaa moahunu,
na adɛn na moda so di ahuhusɛm yi?
13Yei ne onipa ɔbɔnefoɔ kyɛfa a ɔnya no Onyankopɔn hɔ,
ne nhyɛsofoɔ agyapadeɛ a wɔnya no Otumfoɔ nsam:
14 # Hiob 21.19 Sɛ ne mma dɔɔso a, wɔdɔɔso ma afena,
na wɔn a wɔfiri ne mu no aduane remmee wɔn.
15Ne nnipa a wɔbɛka no, owuyadeɛ mu na wɔbɛsie wɔn,
na n’akunafoɔ rensu.
16Sɛ ɔboa dwetɛ ano sɛ mfuturo,
na ɔsiesie ntadeɛ sɛ dɔteɛ a,
17 # Mmb 13.22 ɔsiesie deɛ, nanso ɔteneneeni na ɔbɛhyɛ,
na dwetɛ no, deɛ ɔdi bem na ɔbɛkyɛ mu.
18Ɔsi ne dan sɛ abubummabaa,
na ɛte sɛ sese a ɔwɛmfoɔ yɛ.
19Ɔrekɔda, na ɔyɛ ɔdefoɔ, nso ɔrenna so nyɛ saa bio;
ɔbɛbue n’ani na ɔnni hɔ bio.
20Ahuyideɛ fa no sɛ nsuo,
anadwo na ahum wia no korɔ.
21Apueeɛ mframa soa no kɔ,
na ɛhwim no firi ne tenabea.
22Na ɔto gu ne so, na ɔnni ne ho adɔna,
dwane ara na ɔrepɛ adwane afiri ne nsam.
23Wɔbɛbobɔ nsam agu ne so,
na wɔabɔ ne so hwerɛma de no afiri ne tenabea akɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Hiob kɔɔ so maa n’abebusɛm so sɛ:
Sɛ Onyankopɔn a wayi me bem korɔ
ne Otumfoɔ a ɔhyɛ me kra awerɛhoɔ no te aseɛ yi, —
na m’ahome nyinaa da so wɔ me mu,
na Nyankopɔn ahome da so wɔ me hwene mu yi,
ampa ara, m’ano renka amumuyɛsɛm,
na me tɛkyerɛma renka nnaadaasɛm!
Ɛmpare me sɛ mɛbu mo bem;
meremma wɔnyi me mudie mfiri me ho de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ mɛgyaa mu.
Mɛkura me tenenee mu denden, na merennyaa mu;
m’akoma remmu me fɔ, me nna biara ho.

Me tamfo nyɛ sɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ,
na deɛ ɔma ne ho so tia me no nyɛ sɛ omumuyɛfoɔ.
Na ɛdeɛn ne ɔbɔnefoɔ anidasoɔ berɛ a wɔtwa ne nkwa soɔ,
berɛ a Onyankopɔn twe ne kra korɔ no?
Onyankopɔn bɛte ne sufrɛ
berɛ a ahohiahia bɛba ne soɔ no anaa?
Anaasɛ n’ani bɛgye Otumfoɔ ho,
ɔbɛfrɛ Onyankopɔn berɛ nyinaa mu anaa?
Mɛkyerɛ mo Nyankopɔn nsa ho asɛm,
deɛ ɛwɔ Otumfoɔ hɔ no, merensi so.
Hwɛ, mo deɛ, mo nyinaa moahunu,
na adɛn na moda so di ahuhusɛm yi?

Yei ne onipa ɔbɔnefoɔ kyɛfa a ɔnya no Onyankopɔn hɔ,
ne nhyɛsofoɔ agyapadeɛ a wɔnya no Otumfoɔ nsam:
Sɛ ne mma dɔɔso a, wɔdɔɔso ma afena,
na wɔn a wɔfiri ne mu no aduane remmee wɔn.
Ne nnipa a wɔbɛka no, owuyadeɛ mu na wɔbɛsie wɔn,
na n’akunafoɔ rensu.
Sɛ ɔboa dwetɛ ano sɛ mfuturo,
na ɔsiesie ntadeɛ sɛ dɔteɛ a,
ɔsiesie deɛ, nanso ɔteneneeni na ɔbɛhyɛ,
na dwetɛ no, deɛ ɔdi bem na ɔbɛkyɛ mu.
Ɔsi ne dan sɛ abubummabaa,
na ɛte sɛ sese a ɔwɛmfoɔ yɛ.
Ɔrekɔda, na ɔyɛ ɔdefoɔ, nso ɔrenna so nyɛ saa bio;
ɔbɛbue n’ani na ɔnni hɔ bio.
Ahuyideɛ fa no sɛ nsuo,
anadwo na ahum wia no korɔ.
Apueeɛ mframa soa no kɔ,
na ɛhwim no firi ne tenabea.
Na ɔto gu ne so, na ɔnni ne ho adɔna,
dwane ara na ɔrepɛ adwane afiri ne nsam.
Wɔbɛbobɔ nsam agu ne so,
na wɔabɔ ne so hwerɛma de no afiri ne tenabea akɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
